answer: Seed hidden canary seats: 1 in 20 assignments is a known-bad answer, like a fake orchard report with a stray plume of copied text. Any grader who scores a canary above 1 loses 10% of locked stake. A sybil ring grading by reflex hits canaries in every account, so each added fake grader multiplies expected losses, a cost growing linearly with N. Honest weakness: canaries must look real, and writing a steady supply of them is work, so a delta in quality can leak.
